mintAuthority.summary: cUSDO's Ethereum, Base, and BSC contracts are ERC-4626 USDO wrappers whose public share issuance does not create base USDO; that base issuer path is inherited from usdo-openeden. The EVM wrappers are UUPS-upgradeable by one OpenEden EOA, while the Solana Token-2022 deployment has a direct single-signer mint and freeze authority.

upgradeability.controlRef: OpenEden cUSDO EVM UPGRADE_ROLE admin EOA

controls.label: OpenEden cUSDO Ethereum ERC-4626 wrapper
controls.capDescription: cUSDO shares are minted/burned by the OpenEden ERC-4626-style wrapper against USDO wrap/unwrap; this share accounting cannot create or destroy base USDO supply.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25535942, asset() returned USDO 0x8238884ec9668ef77b90c6dff4d1a9f4f4823bfe; the ERC-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0xb9413a34f68072a362b6a58f46c6af36c4e5d890 and the transparent-admin slot was zero. The verified implementation exposes ERC-4626 deposit/mint against USDO, not issuer-only base-USDO minting.

controls.label: OpenEden cUSDO Base ERC-4626 wrapper
controls.capDescription: Base cUSDO is the same USDO ERC-4626 wrapper implementation; share issuance requires Base USDO and cannot create base USDO supply.
controls.evidence: At Base block 48651922, asset() returned Base USDO 0xad55aebc9b8c03fc43cd9f62260391c13c23e7c0; the ERC-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0xc9c0479cd63ffd5e116430189a9eb6550617f287 and the transparent-admin slot was zero.

controls.label: OpenEden cUSDO BSC ERC-4626 wrapper
controls.capDescription: BSC cUSDO is the same USDO ERC-4626 wrapper implementation; share issuance requires BSC USDO and cannot create base USDO supply.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 110075208, asset() returned BSC USDO 0x302e52afF9815B9D1682473DBFB9C74F9B750AA8; the ERC-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0x99c913b3cbddcfc7ed49ff19b00704286a4b3b6b and the transparent-admin slot was zero.

controls.label: OpenEden cUSDO EVM UPGRADE_ROLE admin EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25535942, Base block 48651922, and BSC block 110075208, this address had no bytecode and held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, UPGRADE_ROLE, and PAUSE_ROLE on the respective cUSDO wrappers. Verified cUSDO source makes UUPS _authorizeUpgrade() require UPGRADE_ROLE; no timelock was observed.

controls.label: cUSDO Solana Token-2022 mint and freeze authority
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 433002244, getAccountInfo for cUSDO mint BnANu5CtUogLqcvBNByJuwaRvRxNtVuDcAytwjsUUtqs returned this same public key as mintAuthority and freezeAuthority. Its account is system-program owned, not a Token-2022 multisig or program account.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25535942, Base block 48651922, and BSC block 110075208, the three EVM cUSDO deployments resolved through zero-admin-slot EIP-1967 proxies to the listed implementations. The same no-bytecode EOA held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, UPGRADE_ROLE, and PAUSE_ROLE on all three, and verified source makes UUPS upgrades depend on UPGRADE_ROLE. These wrappers mint cUSDO only against their chain's USDO asset, so base-USDO issuance remains inherited from usdo-openeden. At finalized Solana slot 433002244, cUSDO's Token-2022 mint and freeze authority was the direct system-account signer FPyi9yJKNX8y5gkadeFvbC2pDB9VVqxpwfofHxJ6Ed7i. Reserve reconciliation: cUSDO is a wrapped form of USDO, and OpenEden's transparency materials describe Chainlink Proof of Reserve as an independent, real-time verification feed for USDO reserve coverage; this is recurring third-party reconciliation rather than issuer-only reporting. Prudential supervision: the Bermuda Monetary Authority registry lists OpenEden Digital Limited (registration number 202403468) with a Class F digital-asset-business licence effective 2026-05-26, matching the legal entity identified for the USDO/cUSDO product. Reviewed 2026-07-15. Economic-control adjudication (2026-07-20): each cUSDO ERC-4626 wrapper mints shares only against USDO actually deposited into that chain's vault and exposes no privileged net-claim mint entry point, so the wrapper cap is economically bounded; base USDO issuance discretion is scored on the parent usdo-openeden profile. M-1 evidence review 2026-08-08: supervision 'prudential' upgraded to primary evidence - BMA register entry read directly (OpenEden Digital Limited, Class F, reg. 202403468, effective 2026-05-26; previously a time-limited Class M expiring 2026-03-31, with an unverifiable ~8-week register gap before Class F took effect) under the DABA prudential regime (BR 98/2018: audited financial statements, business plan, compliance certificate). Reconciliation downgraded continuous -> periodic: no issuer artefact names a reconciliation series; the only named series is the Chainlink usdo-por feed with a daily 86400s heartbeat and porAuditor 'Cross-chain' (no accounting firm), whose declared scope (U.S. Treasury bills only) and value (24,718,359.89 on 2026-08-08) diverge ~9% from the issuer API's full-basket figure (27,161,572.74 incl. RLUSD/USDC/BUIDL/VBILL); the docs transparency page is 7 months stale and still future-tense about a public dashboard.
